page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmg7a.64xlarge is a bare-metal server instance from the ECS Bare Metal family, built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 256 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1024.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core. Operating with a KVM hypervisor foundation and dedicated CPU allocation, the instance provides direct hardware access and isolation without virtualization overhead.

Network connectivity on the ecs.ebmg7a.64xlarge is anchored by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps. The instance provides zero bundled local disk storage and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, meaning persistent storage volumes and external public routing must be provisioned and configured separately through cloud-attached resources.

In terms of qualitative cost efficiency and architecture tradeoffs, the system consolidates extreme compute and memory capacity onto a single physical chassis. The balanced general-purpose resource ratio makes it efficient for massive multi-tenant containers or high-throughput batch platforms. However, workloads requiring high-speed local scratch disks will need to rely strictly on networked block storage.

The ecs.ebmg7a.64xlarge is appropriate for large-scale enterprise applications, high-density container virtualization, distributed analytics nodes, in-memory processing pipelines, and massive web serving infrastructure.
